decisions.Kwic: 下喝，賓主分明，賓則始終賓，主則始終主。雖然如是，未免賓主相待，彼此回互。直須賓不是賓、賓中有主，主不是主、主中有賓，賓主交參、互換無位

Decision.AttributionNote: 二隱謐禪師語錄, hall address raising Linji's guest-and-host exchange. Eryin Mi is the exact speaker of the stored comment: he says that even clearly distinguished guest and host still await and reciprocally interact with one another, then demands their interpenetration and interchange.
